purpose: Test whether the v14a6 target-token learning failure is caused primarily by the gradient-clipping threshold by changing only max_norm while holding the exact target pulse fixed.
parent_lineage: canonical v14a2 with the v14a6 target-pulse construction reused exactly
tokenizer_contract: unchanged from v14a6: tokenizer_v9 with canonical special-token IDs

fixed_controls.target_rows: same deterministic 28 authored rows selected by v14a6
fixed_controls.batch_order: same deterministic v14a6 TargetPulseSampler order in every arm
fixed_controls.lr_schedule: same v14a6 warmup/cosine law on the original 100-update horizon
fixed_controls.objective: full chosen-answer continuation CE with prompt tokens masked

primary_measurements.semantic_secondary: same clean gradient_clipping family evaluator used in v14a6
gradient_diagnostics: applied clip scale for finite-threshold arms

decision_logic.learning_threshold: same v14a6 rule: exact NLL gain >= max(0.05, 1% baseline NLL) OR exact top-1 gain >= 0.02
decision_logic.clip_0p5_update_bottleneck_supported: clip_0p5 fails the learning threshold and at least one looser arm passes it
decision_logic.clip_threshold_not_primary_bottleneck_su: clip_0p5 fails and all looser arms also fail
decision_logic.clip_0p5_learning_failure_not_replicated: clip_0p5 itself passes the learning threshold in the controlled replicate
decision_logic.interpretation_strength: controlled single-factor diagnostic evidence, not causal proof
